doc_summary: a mod's own ingredient kind matching a concrete stack at craft time. The ingredient's test calls native_ingredient_test(kind, data, stack, accept) with the kind and JSON the load-time hook saw, the stack being matched and the verdict, already true (the load-time list named the item). Set accept to false to refuse the stack - its components are the usual reason (ICustomIngredient.test). The hook may be called many times a craft; the answer must be the same for the same stack. Bundles that use it need "hooks": @API:ingredient_test@.
